items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: But I tell you, he'd come stand over you and see whether you was making them notes right or not.

ctx.x: Yeah. And what instrument did Martinez play? Did he ever play?
I don't know. I just didn't see no instrument he played at all. But I tell you, he'd come stand over you and see whether you was making them notes right or not. He'd go from one to another.
